fields.description: Nextcloud base URL including its path, e.g. https://x32.id4net.de/nextcloud
fields.label: Nextcloud URL

fields.description: Nextcloud account the integration acts as, e.g. erpnext.bot. It owns the calendar and the project folders.
fields.label: Bot Username

fields.description: An app password of the bot account (Nextcloud: Personal settings > Security > Devices & sessions), not its login password.
fields.label: App Password

fields.description: Checks the saved settings: logs in as the bot, lists the calendars it can see and looks for the project folder root.
fields.label: Test Connection

fields.description: When on, every approved and submitted Leave Application is written to the Nextcloud calendar below, and removed again when it is cancelled or rejected.
fields.label: Leave Calendar Enabled

fields.description: Display name of the target calendar, exactly as shown in Nextcloud, e.g. Ulrich & Friends
fields.label: Calendar Name

fields.description: Only sync leave of employees whose name contains this text (e.g. Test while testing). Leave empty to sync everyone.
fields.label: Only Employees Containing

fields.description: When on, every new Project gets its folder tree (customer folder, Akquisition, project folder with Arbeitsergebnisse, PM, Vertraege) below the folder root. Existing folders are kept, nothing is ever deleted.
fields.label: Project Folders Enabled

fields.description: Folder in the bot's Nextcloud files that holds the customer folders. It must exist already (create it once as the bot and share it with the team).
fields.label: Folder Root

fields.description: Only create folders for projects whose name contains this text (e.g. ZZ-TEST while testing). Leave empty for all projects.
fields.label: Only Projects Containing
